name: Renal Pelvis
short_description: Funnel-shaped structure that collects urine from the kidney.

name: Renal Medulla
short_description: Inner part of the kidney containing renal pyramids.

name: Renal Cortex
short_description: Outer layer of the kidney that filters blood and produces urine.

name: Renal Artery
short_description: Blood vessel carrying blood to the kidney for filtration.

name: Renal Vein
short_description: Blood vessel that carries filtered blood away from the kidney.

name: Renal Capsule
short_description: Fibrous outer covering of the kidney.

name: Renal Pyramids
short_description: Cone-shaped tissues in the medulla containing nephron tubules.

name: Major Calyx
short_description: Receives urine from the papilla of renal pyramids
